By changing the model: through latent effects in the conditional mean (Days 2-3), into the probability of the graph itself (Day 4), across time (Day 5). Today is a genuinely new cell: leave the model alone and interrogate the design: what would it take for any of those coefficients to be read as a causal effect, and what can you do when the answer is “more than my data can deliver”?
